high_findings.title: Proposal-safe claims are not reconciled with explicit claim restrictions
high_findings.finding: EvidenceRecord permits the same claim in safe_claims and claims_requiring_additional_evidence, while ProfileBundle checks only membership in safe_claims. The performance_claims_allowed flag is also not consulted during claim resolution, allowing an explicitly restricted performance claim to be promoted into a proposal-safe claim.
high_findings.preferred_safe_fix: Reject overlap between safe and restricted claims, require a typed claim category, enforce performance_claims_allowed during resolution, and add negative regression coverage.

known_limitations: The captures passed all recorded gates, but the suite did not cover the demonstrated contradictory-claim case.
Only HERBACORIUM is owner-verified for completed-client-work claims.
